scenes.headline: What Pokee-Isaac 28B does with ten million tokens
scenes.sub: A 28B dense model on one GPU, and the architecture its report leaves out.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quill! Pokee-Isaac claims ten million tokens of context on one GPU. Here's what it does, and what its report shows.

scenes.text: Long-context agents have been cloud-only. A 28B dense model holding retrieval across 10M tokens on one GPU could run where data can't leave.
scenes.say: The idea: long-context agents have lived in the cloud. A small model holding retrieval across ten million tokens could run where data can't leave.

steps.say: Pokee-Isaac is a twenty-eight billion parameter dense model, with some weights fine-tuned from Qwen3.6-27B.
It reads up to ten million tokens. How, the report doesn't say: it calls the design non-decoder-only, and never explains what that means.
It's sized to run on one B200 in a datacenter, one RTX 4090 or 5090 at a desk, or an NPU at the edge.

left.title: Prefill: the whole prompt
items: Compute-bound, so it rises with context
left.say: Prefill reads the whole prompt as one big matrix multiply. It's compute-bound, so it speeds up with context, to a hundred and thirty-seven thousand tokens a second.

right.title: Decode: token by token
items: A matrix-vector step against the cache
right.say: Decode writes one token at a time against the cache. It's bound by memory bandwidth, so it stays flat, around three hundred and thirty-five a second.

scenes.title: RULER retrieval score as context grows
scenes.note: 10 samples per task setting, on Pokee's own runs
scenes.say: On the RULER retrieval test it holds ninety-three to ninety-seven percent all the way to ten million tokens. The cloud models it's tested against fail by one million.

scenes.quote: matches or exceeds the strongest cost-optimized cloud systems on function calling, multi-turn interactive execution, tool orchestration, and terminal work
scenes.say: The abstract says it matches or beats the cheap cloud tier on four agent tasks. Its own tables back about half: it trails on tool orchestration and terminal work.

scenes.text: What's new is where it could run: a long-context agent inside a data boundary, on one GPU.

recap: Prefill rises with context; decode stays flat
The architecture itself is still undisclosed
scenes.say: To recap: a small long-context model, two very different speeds, and an architecture still to be shown.
